- Preferred delivery: our AP team prefers invoices uploaded to a vendor portal (we can accept SFTP or vendor portal links). If email PDFs must be used, they need to go to accounting@acmedata.com and cc procurement@acmedata.com.
- First invoice should reference PO #45872.

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tom Browne <tom.browne@acmedata.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing: invoice delivery preferences and VAT details

Hi Erin — great to hear and thanks for sending the PO + W9. Quick summary of options and what we'll need to get you fully set up: 

1) Redwood Billing Portal (recommended)
- We can invite your AP email(s) to the Redwood vendor portal. Once invited, they can download PDF invoices, monthly CSVs, and set notification preferences. Portal invoices include line-item usage and your PO on the PDF.
- Portal retention is configurable (standard: 2 years).

2) Direct email delivery
- We can email each invoice PDF to accounting@acmedata.com and cc any additional addresses you want. This is a simple stop-gap if you prefer not to onboard the portal immediately.

VAT handling: if your EU subsidiary is VAT-registered and you want invoices billed to that legal entity, we typically issue a separate invoice with that entity's name and VAT registration number. If a reverse-charge mechanism applies, please provide the VAT number and country and we'll add the proper wording.

Next steps I propose: 
- Confirm the billing contact(s) (name, role, email) you want invited to the portal.
- Confirm whether you want first invoice sent by email as well (often useful while portal invite is pending).
- Send the VAT reg number(s) and any billing entity names if separate invoicing is required.

I attached a short setup guide that shows the portal invite flow and where the invoices live. If you want, I can loop in our finance ops (cc'ing Marissa) to enable the portal and create the first invoice so you can verify PO matching.

Best,

--
Olga Petrov
Account Manager, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0178

Attachments: Redwood-Invoice-Setup-Instructions.pdf

- I'll create the vendor record for Acme Data (D-ACME-1034) and enable portal invites for accounting@acmedata.com and erin@acmedata.com.
- We'll issue the first invoice dated 2026-09-30 and include PO #45872. I'll also send a copy via email to accounting@acmedata.com as Erin requested so their AP team has it immediately.
- VAT: If Acme wants the EU entity billed, we need the legal entity name and VAT reg number (country + number). If they don't provide a VAT number, we'll bill the US entity and apply standard US invoice formatting.

Action items for internal: 
- Sean: confirm tax-code for vendor (US vs EU split) and whether to generate separate invoices for subsidiaries.
- Vanessa: run the invoice PDF template with line-item rates to ensure PO mapping is visible (customer wants PO on the invoice header).

Attaching VAT guidance doc for quick reference.
